text.feels_intro: How {name}'s drained life force feels right now; let this shape {his} tone, posture and movement:
text.feels_outro: Answer must be creative and different, repetition will be punished.

head: {name}'s face: pale and drawn, faint grey shadows under {his} eyes where the warmth was pulled out of {him}.
{name}'s face: ashen and hollow-cheeked, lips bloodless and bluish, the veins at {his} temples dark and sunken. The skin is cold to the touch.
{name}'s face: grey as a corpse, the skin papery and clinging to the bone, eyes dull and sunken deep in dark rings. A faint chill hangs about {him}.
body: {name}'s back: the skin is pale and cool, gooseflesh standing up where the life was drawn out.
{name}'s back: grey, clammy skin with dark veins showing through, the flesh oddly slack. {name} shivers without cold.
{name}'s back: withered and grey, the skin thin and loose over the ribs and spine as if years had been taken. {name} is cold as stone.
arm: {name}'s {part}: pale and cool, the fingers a little numb and slow.
{name}'s {part}: grey and clammy, dark veins standing out, the muscle slack and trembling.
{name}'s {part}: withered and grey, the skin hanging loose on the bone, the hand curled and nerveless.
leg: {name}'s {part}: pale and cool, a little heavy and numb.
{name}'s {part}: grey and clammy, dark veins showing, the muscle trembling under {his} weight.
{name}'s {part}: withered and grey, the flesh shrunken to the bone; it barely holds {him} up.

head: {name} feels light-headed and chilled, as if {he} had stood up too fast. {name} blinks and steadies {reflexive}.
{name} feels dizzy and hollow, the world dimming at the edges and {his} thoughts slow. {name} is frightened and speaks faintly.
{name} feels the life ebbing out of {him}; {his} sight swims and darkens and {his} heart flutters weakly. {name} can barely keep {his} eyes open or form words.
body: {name} feels a cold, tired ache spreading through {his} chest. {name} is uneasy and short of breath.
{name} feels drained and hollow inside, cold to the core, every breath an effort. {name} sways and hugs {reflexive}.
{name} feels empty, as if {his} warmth and strength have been poured out of {him}; {his} heart stumbles. {name} is close to fainting and terrified.
arm: {name}'s {part} feels weak and tingling. {name} flexes the fingers to wake them.
{name}'s {part} feels cold and leaden, the grip failing. {name} lets it hang.
{name}'s {part} feels dead and numb, too weak to lift. {name} cannot hold anything.
leg: {name}'s {part} feels weak and shaky. {name} shifts {his} weight carefully.
{name}'s {part} feels cold and leaden and trembles under {him}. {name} moves slowly, unsteady.
{name}'s {part} feels dead and numb and will not bear {him}. {name} sinks down and cannot rise.

levels: , a cold pull as a thin red stream of life is drawn out through the skin. {name} shivers and the colour fades from {name}'s face.
, the life torn out of flesh already grey and chilled. {name} sways, breath catching, as warmth and strength flow away in a crimson thread.
, and the drain bites deep into what little is left. {name}'s skin turns ashen and slack, {name}'s knees buckle and the light in {name}'s eyes dims.
, and it is too much. The last warmth is pulled out of {name}; {name} goes grey and hollow, sagging like an empty sack, breath barely stirring.

start_unhurt.other: {owner} {noun} surrounds {obj} in a warm yellow swirling light. With no wounds to mend, it simply feels warm and soothing.

hit.again_many: keep drawing the life out of {target}

head: the last of {name}'s life is pulled out through the face in a crimson stream; the cheeks sink, the lips shrivel back from the teeth and the eyes dry and sink into the skull. {name} sags, a grey, withered husk, cold before it touches the ground.
the drain tears the life from {name} until the skin of the face turns grey and papery and cracks like old parchment; {name}'s eyes roll up, dull and empty, and {name} crumples without a sound.
body: the drain draws the life out of {name}'s chest until the heart stutters and stops; the body shrinks inside the clothes, ribs standing out under grey, sunken skin. {name} falls as a dry, cold husk.
the crimson stream pours out of {name}'s body until nothing is left; the flesh withers and slackens, the skin turns ashen and loose, and {name} folds to the ground, light as a bundle of sticks.
arm: the drain pulls the life out through {name}'s {part} and the withering spreads up the shoulder and across the chest; {name}'s hand curls into a grey claw and {name} collapses, shrunken and cold.
{name}'s {part} shrivels to grey skin and bone as the last life is drawn out; the cold races inward to the heart and {name} drops, eyes empty and staring.
leg: the drain draws the life out of {name}'s {part} and the grey withering climbs through the body; {name} sinks to {name}'s knees, then falls, a shrunken, cold husk.
{name}'s {part} withers to bone and slack skin and the drain pulls on until {name}'s heart gives out; {name} slumps, ashen and hollow, all warmth gone.
